title: Polygon co-founder mulls resurrecting MATIC a year after POL rebrand
summary: Polygon’s co-founder said even small merchants and drivers recognized MATIC, but many struggle to locate POL since the token’s rebrand.

title: Strategy unveils new credit gauge to calm debt fears after Bitcoin crash
summary: Strategy said it has a 70-year dividend runway even after Bitcoin’s slide, rolling out a new credit rating metric to ease fears over DAT liquidation risks.

title: Blockrise wins Dutch MiCA license, brings Bitcoin-backed loans to EU businesses
summary: Blockrise secures a MiCA license in the Netherlands, unlocking regulated Bitcoin custody and trading while paving the way for BTC-backed business loans across Europe.

title: Tether’s 116-ton gold hoard rivals reserves of Korea and Hungary: Jefferies
summary: Tether accounted for almost 2% of global gold demand last quarter, with Jefferies noting that its aggressive buying may be influencing short-term market sentiment.

title: FCA trials crypto transparency templates as UK shapes new rulebook
summary: Eunice will trial standardized crypto disclosure templates with major exchanges, feeding real-world data into the UK’s evolving 2026 rulebook.

title: Trump-backed WLFI ramps up buybacks as token lingers 50% below launch price
summary: The Trump family-backed WLFI purchased nearly $8 million worth of tokens, aiming to mitigate the downtrend of the token by artificially reducing the outstanding supply.

title: Edel Finance-linked wallets reportedly ‘snipe’ 30% of token supply: Bubblemaps
summary: Bubblemaps shared blockchain data indicating that team-related wallets had purchased 30% of the token supply, but Edel’s co-founder said the acquisition was part of its token rollout plans.

title: Naver to acquire Upbit operator Dunamu in $10.3B all-stock deal
summary: Naver Financial plans to acquire Dunamu in a $10.3 billion stock-swap deal, issuing 87.56 million new shares and making the crypto giant a wholly owned subsidiary.

title: BIS taps IMF digital money chief and CBDC backer as new head of Innovation Hub
summary: The Bank for International Settlements is advancing major digital currency pilots, testing cross-border CBDCs, tokenized deposits and real-time payment rails.

title: Bitcoin eyes rebound to $96K from current ‘discount’ zone: Analysis
summary: A Bitcoin bull flag on the price charts projected a rebound to $96,000 as the Puell Multiple indicator suggested that BTC is undervalued at current prices.
